messages:
ops-bot: Alert: increased edge LB retries for cross-region requests detected by retry-sentinel (possible TLS handshake failures).
julia: Seeing a narrow spike ~19:22 UTC, mostly traffic that transited us-west -> eu-central. Errors show TLS unexpected_message during resume.
sam-w: I looked at deploy logs — rollout-2043 touched sni-policy + a route reconciliation tweak around 19:10. Could be a propagation race.
leo: quick repro from ap-south probe to eu-central: curl shows 502 and TLS error.
```
$ curl -sS -I https://api.redwood.example/health --resolve api.redwood.example:443:54.12.34.56
HTTP/2 502
* TLS handshake error: unexpected message
```
marie: Keep actions tight, assign owners and short ETAs.
sam-w: Action 1: Confirm if rollout-2043 applied sni-policy twice or retried applies during zone-sync. Owner: @sam-w. ETA: 8h. Ticket NET-4987.
sam-w: Action 2: Hotfix: temporarily increase client retry backoff for cross-region routes to reduce amplification. Owner: @julia. ETA: 1h.
leo: Action 3: Deploy tls-resume-canary that hits resume/reneg paths across regions. Owner: @leo. ETA: 36h. Alert if retry rate >2x baseline.
marie: Action 4: Add guard in route reconciler to dedupe SNI apply operations when overlapping updates detected. Owner: @marie. ETA: 5 days. RFC NET-4988.
sam-w: Observability: add rollout_id header to ingress logs for faster correlation. Owner: @sam-w. ETA: 72h.
julia: Note: pattern looks similar to other incidents where config churn + TLS session state caused retry storms. Recommend persistent metric "tls_resume_retry_rate" tagged by rollout.
marie: Scheduling 25-min sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC to review NET-4987/4988 and pick postmortem lead. Will update this thread after the meeting.
ops-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress (hotfix in flight). Severity: Sev2. Updates will be appended here.
